quests.title: Ground Worth Crossing
quests.text: A crossing that carries one scout may put a loaded crew straight through the surface. Use the prepared sighting frame at the {name:front_broken_causeway/crossing_stand} to judge where the ground will bear their weight, then report to me. I would like the next report on a weak spot to arrive before the people standing on it.

objectives.label: Sight the ground for the crossing

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft AL1: a use at the new recipe place P3 (the Causeway's wraithwood); Stormvault's first armor choice.

quests.title: Put the City to Work
quests.text: Front repairs need tools, replacement fittings and someone willing to make a city dispatch them. Speak to Dorrin Gateledger in Dur Brannoc; he coordinates the work from there and needs help with the loads going out and coming back. Tell him Alna wants something she can build with, and he will spare you the ceremonial part.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only): a departure to a giver with work at once.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft AL2 (K1 A): the free departure to Dorrin at 45; the check's fix: no 'Guild' in the title (Dorrin is the envoy, Hadrin the guild leader).

quests.title: The Burn Beneath the Stamp
quests.text: Copperfell's purse forgers used this style of stamp; the new Tithe-Brand burns where theirs left ink. Take a rubbing of the scorched mark at {name:brandscar_cairn}, {dir_from_giver:brandscar_cairn}. Bring me three Siege Bones from Tollroad Skeletons in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, after dark. My runesmiths need to compare what the brand does to stone with what it does to a soldier.
quests.completion: The burn in these bones matches the rubbing: fresh payment is keeping old soldiers in service. Senn pays the dead who hold his crossing, but we have yet to learn who supplies him. I need his toll-box opened before another traveller becomes part of its takings.

objectives.label: Take a rubbing of the brand

quests.lesson: The top belt of the Causeway at night.

quests.title: Collection Ends Here
quests.text: The smiths found the same burn in the bones: {name:toll_taker_senn} pays dead soldiers in branded coin to keep them on duty. At the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, defeat five Aqueduct Bowmen or Coal-Purse Factors in all; they guard his takings day and night. Kill Senn as well, then turn out the branded toll-box at {name:r20_anchor_078}. I want to see who considers a road full of corpses a sound investment.
quests.completion: Senn was paid to keep the crossing deadly, and Paymaster Chirr's remittance promises more money for more of the same. The bundle bears a seal of The Throng, but a seal on a wrapper does not identify the hand that filled it. The Warmaster must examine this payment circuit; I can read the burn, but a fortress pay office is his responsibility.
quests.lesson: Causeway climax and the main line's chapter 1 climax: a bowman camp, its named normal leader and Senn's toll-box.

quests.title: Good Paper, Bad Company
quests.text: Senn's accounts say more than he ever did: he was paid to keep the road deadly, and his tolls went back to the factors for another branding and another round of wages. A remittance from Paymaster Chirr in The Skyglass Canopy promises more of the same. The bundle came wrapped in a requisition under a seal of The Throng, on paper fit for a fortress pay office. Take all of it to the Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}; paper this good deserves an awkward question, and I'd rather it came from someone whose job it is.
quests.completion: These accounts establish a circuit: tolls return to the factors, the factors brand the coin, and fresh pay keeps the dead at work. Audra's ordinary supply requests remain valid; the seal on this money is grounds for inquiry, not a verdict on its sender. Nella Hedgeward reports a standard pledged against the same pay on The Shattered Line, and I will give you orders to examine it.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 1 (last turn-in): the handoff from Archshadow Post back to the Warmaster.

quests.title: Ready for the Repair Crew
quests.text: There is a tool load held for front repairs at Stormvault Mining Camp's loading ground. Check the prepared bundles and ready them for the repair crews, then bring me word. A sound tool left waiting behind a rope repairs very little.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft AL3: the Stormvault camp's free held load (a town place); Stormvault's weapon (a solo quest).

quests.title: Before the Weight Comes
quests.text: Gravesalt has plenty worth salvaging, provided the ground holds while we lift it. Use the sighting frame at the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/shoring_check} to check where our shoring can take a load, then report to me. I count a crew member as considerably harder to replace than a beam.

objectives.label: Sight the ground for the shoring

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft BO1: a use at the new recipe place P4 (Gravesalt's saltflats); free from Borin's arrival at 50; Stormvault's first 51-60 armor choice.

quests.title: Ask About the Roots
quests.text: My crews brace what they can in Gravesalt; Eriath Boughwarden has carriers picking their way through The Skyglass Canopy. Go and speak to him in Lethariel about the help they need. He understands the roots under those paths, and I am willing to admit that a root is a beam with opinions.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only): a departure to a giver with work at once.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft BO2: the free departure to Eriath at 51 (Eriath's work opens at 51).

quests.title: Put Down the Tools
quests.text: The salvage crews keep calling a mouthful between lifts a meal. Bring me five Storm Tuna, and I'll have a proper supper waiting when their shift ends. They can put down the tools long enough to use a plate.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft BO3: the early 51-60 potion choice (from 52).

quests.title: Braces Before Salvage
quests.text: I have bracing timbers set aside at the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/work_laydown} for the next salvage crew. Check the bundles and ready the load there before anyone goes looking for something heavy to lift. The time to discover a missing brace is while the weight is still on the ground.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft BO4 (K10 A: held_supplies, no new object): a use at the new recipe place P5 (Gravesalt's blight terraces); Stormvault's second 51-60 armor choice.

quests.title: The Last Watch Ends
quests.text: Fresh branded pay reaches the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood}, and the Last-Watch Sentries shoulder their weapons for another night. Destroy five there after dark, then defeat {name:watch_captain_huskell}, {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}. His roll should tell us who keeps paying for the watch; somebody has to relieve it, and it may as well be you.
quests.completion: Soldiers from both armies, bought back onto the watch, and Odren Vell freshly entered at the foot: the clerk has landed in his own account. The roll proves he is bound, but gives us no place to find him. Eriath Boughwarden watches Chirr's payments in The Skyglass Canopy; I have a page he needs to read.
quests.lesson: Gravesalt climax: its named normal leader at the heart of the escarpment.

quests.title: The Clerk at the Foot
quests.text: Huskell's roll is no muster list but a page of the Undertithe's own: soldiers from both armies, each name bought back onto duty with branded pay. Odren Vell is written at the foot in fresh ink; the coin has collected its own clerk. Take the page to Eriath Boughwarden in Lethariel, who remembers the old forged bough-seals and whose watchers keep an eye on Chirr's payments in The Skyglass Canopy. He'll need three graceful sentences to agree with me.
quests.completion: Borin is right: Huskell held the names on duty, and Chirr keeps paying to renew their service. My watchers have located his Last-Pay Archers and Ash-Writ Bowmen, though we cannot yet tell how far their burning entries reach. I will send you to the paymaster before he buys another watch.

quests.title: Party: Nothing Left to Count
quests.text: {name:salt_counter_witch} sits in the Gravesalt mires, {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, counting soldiers as entries to spend. Huskell keeps them on watch; she is already adding up what they might fetch. Gather a party and kill the elite witch. I'd like the next count in that mire to come out at nothing.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft BO5 (K11 A): the optional group quest on Salt-Counter, standalone from its level; its id and objective stay, its prerequisite goes; a trinket choice.
